repair-tier1
━━━━━━━━━━━
SQL aggregates over fact tables
staging + EXCHANGE TABLES
━━━━━━━━━━━
T1 ← MIN ledger_sequence FROM transaction_participants
T2 ← MIN FROM operations_appearances WHERE type=22
T3 ← MIN FROM nft_ownership WHERE event_type=0
T7 ← MIN FROM nft_ownership_pending WHERE event_type=0
T11+T12 ← argMin over soroban_contracts
WHERE deployer_id IS NOT NULL
